collection.title: BMW 8 Series Coupe/Gran Coupe 1990 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW 8 Series Coupe/Gran Coupe 1990 to 1999 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
